landing.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know to create and deploy your QR codes with confidence.
landing.faqQ1: What is the difference between a static and a dynamic QR code?
landing.faqA1: A static QR code permanently encodes your information (text, Wi-Fi, fixed URL) in the geometric matrix: it cannot be modified after printing. A dynamic QR code points to a secure short link (/s/my-link) that redirects to your website: you can modify the destination at any time without reprinting your materials, and you benefit from detailed scan analytics.
landing.faqQ2: Are my QR codes compatible with all smartphones?
landing.faqA2: Absolutely. Our QR codes are 100% compliant with the international ISO/IEC 18004 standard. They are instantly recognized by the native camera on iOS (iPhone) and Android, with no third-party app required.
landing.faqQ3: How to guarantee perfect paper printing without pixelation?
landing.faqA3: For professional printing (posters, packaging, storefronts), download your QR code in vector SVG or 4096px PNG at 300 DPI. The vector format preserves infinite mathematical sharpness regardless of magnification.
landing.faqQ4: Does adding a logo risk preventing the QR code from scanning?
landing.faqA4: No, because QRCraft includes an automatic excavation algorithm that clears the modules beneath your logo, and automatically boosts the error correction level (Reed-Solomon) to 25% (Q) or 30% (H). Even with a central logo, the QR code remains perfectly readable.
landing.faqQ5: Do QR codes created on the free plan have an expiration date?
landing.faqA5: No, your static QR codes remain valid for life without any expiration date. Your direct links will continue to function indefinitely.
landing.footerTagline: The next-generation Micro-SaaS to generate, style, print in high resolution, and track your custom QR codes.
